articles.title: US-Israel war on Iran: What’s happening on day 27 of attacks?

The escalation in intensity comes amidst conflicting claims regarding ongoing negotiations. articles.title: Terror Premiere New Single & Lyric Video "Destruction Of My Soul" From Upcoming New Album "Still Suffer"
articles.summary: Hardcore band Terror is set to release their ninth studio album, "Still Suffer," in less than a month. Fans can already preview new material as the band has unveiled a lyric video for their track, "Destructio." This upcoming release marks another significant addition to Terror's extensive discography, promising new music for their global fanbase as the album's launch date approaches.

articles.title: India's Compound Archery Team Dominates Asia Cup
articles.summary: India's compound archery team is excelling at the Asia Cup, demonstrating remarkable skill by securing numerous final berths and medals. In contrast, the recurve team is facing challenges and struggling to meet performance expectations at the same international competition. This showcases a mixed performance for India in a prominent Asian sporting event.

articles.title: Manipur: Gunfight erupts between Army, militants
articles.summary: The Indian Army engaged in a 30-minute gunfight with insurgents in Manipur's Bishnupur district on Thursday, as confirmed by a police statement. This incident highlights the persistent internal security challenges in the region, where security forces actively combat insurgency. Such operations are crucial for maintaining peace and order, underscoring the Army's vital role in national security.

articles.title: Kumar Mangalam Birla’s Mumbai Home: Inside a ₹425 crore icon of luxury living

Key features include multiple bedrooms, spacious living areas, a private dining room, and dedicated personal spaces like a home office and library. The property is equipped with everything expected in a high-end residence, catering to ultimate comfort and luxury.

articles.title: After Galwan clashes, ITBP strengthens presence with 29 new outposts along China border
articles.summary: The Indo-Tibetan Border Police (ITBP) has established 29 new Border Outposts (BoPs) along the India-China frontier between 2022 and 2024, raising the total to 209. This strategic expansion significantly enhances surveillance, improves rapid-response capabilities, and strengthens security preparedness in the challenging high-altitude terrain, vital for national defence and maintaining vigilance along the Line of Actual Control.

articles.title: Space co Agnikul successfully tests 3D-printed ‘Agnite’ booster engine
articles.summary: Indian space startup Agnikul Cosmos successfully test-fired its 3D-printed 'Agnite' rocket booster engine. This marks a significant milestone in indigenous space technology, demonstrating advanced additive manufacturing for propulsion systems. This achievement enhances India's private space sector capabilities, potentially enabling more cost-effective and efficient rocket launches, boosting national self-reliance in space exploration and defence applications.
